title: Data source candidate
description: One researched candidate data source, written by the research-sources skill to research/candidates/<slug>.json. Mirrors the fields the add-data-source skill needs to decide whether to build an adapter.

slug.description: Matches the candidate's filename stem and its memo's slug.

url.description: Primary documentation or dataset landing page.

granularity.description: e.g. tract, ZCTA, county, MSA, national.

history_available.description: How far back usable history goes.

cost.description: Confirmation it's actually free, plus any rate limit.

license.description: License/ToS summary, incl. any commercial-use or attribution clause.

evaluated_quantitatively.description: Whether app/research/evaluate_series.py was run against this candidate. False if that tool doesn't exist yet.

correlation_results.description: Correlation/lead-lag vs FHFA tract HPI growth and Zillow ZORI, if computed.

relevant_gap.description: Which existing scoring/investment input this would feed or improve.

existing_overlap.description: What's already covered in backend/app/sources/ that this would duplicate, if anything.
